name: pinchOut (zoom out)
description: Mirrors GestureHelper.pinchOut() in utils/gestureHelper.ts (two fingers moving apart vertically, offset=100px/200px). Original code uses raw pixel offsets from screen center; here they're expressed as percentages converted against this session's device resolution (1080x2340 - the Genymotion Galaxy S24 emulator). On a different device resolution the pinch will still work but won't be pixel-identical to the framework's runtime behavior.
